values.meaning: recast stun duration on secondary targets
values.quote: all secondary targets hit are {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: The ability deals damage to the first enemy hit on cast, and the same damage to enemies hit again on recast (knockback).
mechanics.quote: fires a hook in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them

mechanics.claim: Damage instances apply spell damage to the primary target and area damage to secondary targets.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets.

mechanics.claim: The recast deals the same damage as the initial cast to enemies it passes through.
mechanics.quote: dealing the same damage to enemies they pass through

mechanics.claim: While the target is tethered, Renata cannot attack and has her movement speed reduced by 30%.
mechanics.quote: '''Renata''' to become unable to declare attacks and have her {{as|movement speed}} '''reduced''' by {{as|30%|ms}}

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts post-effect if an enemy is hit, or on-cast if not.
mechanics.quote: Starts post-effect if an enemy is hit, on-cast if not

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the initial hook, but not the recast's effects as the primary target; as a secondary target the recast's effects are blocked.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the hook but not the recast's effects as the primary target.
